summary.text: Tom Murphy is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 9B who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former agriculture products sales representative and business owner, he lives in Underwood and faces Democrat Owen Werner in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Tom Murphy grew up in Scott County and lives in Underwood, Minnesota.
He earned a B.S. in marketing from Minnesota State University, Mankato.

His career experience includes working as a sales representative for an agriculture products company, owning a dairy supply sales business, and owning and operating MinStart Ag Products, and he became a township supervisor for Maine Township and joined the board of directors of the Park Region Telephone Company.
Murphy defeated Jason Satter in the 2022 and 2024 general elections for District 9B.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Human Services Finance and Policy, Climate and Energy Finance and Policy (Co-Vice Chair), and House Transportation Finance and Policy committees.
